# Element Pay Partner API — agent reading list

Read these paths **in order** before implementing. Prefer Markdown + OpenAPI over Mintlify UI chrome.

## 1. Must read first

- `AGENTS.md` — one-page pointer
- `docs/agents.md` — install, auth, sandbox OnRamp happy path, webhooks, pitfalls
- `openapi.yaml` — machine-readable contract (servers, security, paths, webhook schemas)
- `docs/integration-fiat-stablecoin.md` — local fiat ↔ USDC/USDT (OnRamp + OffRamp)

## 2. Supporting guides (same repo)

- `authentication.mdx` — `X-API-Key` (`is_test_` / `is_live_`)
- `webhooks.mdx` — events, HMAC-SHA256 verify, `X-Webhook-Id` idempotency
- `errors.mdx` — envelope + HTTP statuses
- `quickstart.mdx` — KYC → KE OnRamp quote → accept
- `orders/quote-and-accept.mdx` — binding quote fields and examples
- `corridors/kenya.mdx` — KES momo/bank discovery + sandbox phones
- `sandbox/success-failure.mdx` — **sandbox-only** success/failure triggers
- `docs/KNOWN_GAPS.md` — conflicts, TODOs, undocumented surfaces

## 3. Optional (after first payment works)

- `customers/quickstart.mdx` — vault KYC details
- `corridors/overview.mdx` — discovery endpoints + USDC/USDT assets
- `customers/conversions.mdx` — ledger fiat↔fiat FX (**not** corridor ramps)
- `customers/payouts.mdx` — external bank payouts (banking product)
- `postman/Element-Pay-Partner-API.postman_collection.json` — importable curls

## 4. Do not treat as source of truth alone

- Mintlify-rendered pages without checking `openapi.yaml`
- Hardcoded `network_id` UUIDs from guides — always fetch from **your** sandbox `GET /partner/catalog`
- Inline `customer` on quote (deprecated; use vault `customer_id`)

## Base URLs

| Env | Base |
|-----|------|
| Sandbox | `https://sandbox.elementpay.net/api/v1` |
| Production | `https://api.elementpay.net/api/v1` |

Partner routes: `{BASE}/partner/*`
